slides.texte_overlay:
how to become the most
magnetic person in any room

the room scan

when you walk into a room, pause in the doorway for two seconds and look around before moving. people who take their time arriving always look like they belong, wherever they go.

remembering one thing

when you meet someone new, remember one detail they tell you and bring it up later. being remembered is rare enough that people never forget who did it.

genuine curiosity

ask people about the thing they light up talking about, then just listen without planning your answer. everyone is magnetic to someone who finds them genuinely interesting.

a story a day

spend 5 minutes a day learning one great story from history, science or art. people gather around whoever always has a good story to tell, and stories are learned, not born.

no phone in hand

walk into every room this week without your phone in your hand. holding it is a shield, and people can always feel it when you're actually there with them.
